gt.full_text:
Travel Reimbursement Policy (excerpt)
Policy no.: FIN-77
Effective: October 1, 2026
Owner: Finance
1. Meals
Employees on approved travel receive a per diem of $65 per full day. Travel days are paid at 75% of the per diem.
2. Mileage
Use of a personal car is reimbursed at $0.70 per mile. Parking and tolls are reimbursed at cost with receipts.
3. Lodging
Hotel rates up to $180 per night are pre-approved. Higher rates need written approval from the budget owner.
4. Claims
Submit claims within 30 days of returning. Claims submitted later than 30 days may be declined.
Item | Limit | Receipt needed
Per diem | $65/day | No
Mileage | $0.70/mile | Log only
Hotel | $180/night | Yes
Page 1 of 1
